messages.content: Cached input tokens cost 10% of the base input rate when your prompt prefix matches exactly.

Here is our pricing doc for reference:
PRICING POLICY v2 — Effective March 2026. All API usage is billed per million tokens, input and output separately. Cached input tokens are billed at ten percent of the base input rate when a prompt cache prefix matches exactly. Batch requests receive a fifty percent discount on both input and output tokens. Rate limits are enforced per organization per model class, with burst allowances negotiated for enterprise accounts. Overage beyond committed spend is billed at on-demand rates at the end of each calendar month.PRICING POLICY v2 — Effective March 2026.
